column4: isometric shed: blue-grey concrete tiles, yellow-black hazard strips, red brick walls with skylights, white CNC blocks with glass doors, panels and 3-lamp status lights; blue cables to the rack; pixel workers in blue overalls and yellow helmets; orange parts on the belt and coins rising over the crate (index.html:557, index.html:379)
base seen like a mobile base-builder with tappable detailed machines; calm production with coins collected from crates, no failure
2.5D isometric view with drag pan and wheel/pinch/+- zoom (index.html:328)
grid shed with pan and zoom; placing highlights free slots in green and shows a ghost machine under the pointer (index.html:625)
five machines with unlock levels 1,2,3,5,7 in the shop; each drawn with its own silhouette (evidence/figures.png)
the line's machine order is looked up in 15 recipes plus scrap; the recipe book fills as parts are sold (index.html:205, index.html:736, evidence/recipes.png)

assembly (bolts in order), network (cable path on a grid, evidence/mg-rete.png), configuration (needle in the green, evidence/mg-config.png); percentage from time against the best time (index.html:848)
XP from minigames, sales and recipes raises the level; level-ups unlock machines, expansions and tool levels with a banner
wrench, crimper and tester each upgrade 4 levels; they cut bolt turns and crimp taps and widen/slow the dial, so each minigame finishes faster (index.html:218)
coins rise from the crate on every sale; income per minute under the money; goal always shown top right (index.html:742, index.html:1068)
pixel workers wander the walkways and walk to machines being built; autosave every 5 s and on events, Continua on the title (index.html:668, index.html:295)
machines bought in the shop, placed on a slot, then built through the three phases (index.html:796)
network minigame: drag the cable from the rack around pillars, pallets and oil to the machine, then crimp
assembly minigame: tap the numbered bolts in order, several turns each
configuration minigame: stop the needle in the green zone of each parameter; Ricalibra replays it later
T then L on the line shows a new part worth 45 at this quality; swapping or moving machines changes the recipe (index.html:710)
machines locked behind levels show Livello N until reached
tools upgraded with coins, gated by player level, make minigames faster
stand-in: three expansions (Linea 2, linee lunghe, Linea 3) open new floor bays, a new line and a worker; the shed grows on screen (index.html:824, index.html:534)
opens on a near-empty shed, 500 coins, a pixel worker waving with a welcome bubble
the arrow points to Negozio, then to Compra, then to the slot; free slots glow green with a ghost; placing plays a clack (index.html:811)
assembly starts right after placing; tap bolts in numbered order; result shows a percentage (evidence/mg-result.png)
drag the cable from the rack across the grid around obstacles
stop the needle in the green for spindle speed, feed and depth
the saw lights green, cut bars go down the belt and coins rise; Barra tagliata recipe banner
after the build rewards the player can afford the lathe; the arrow asks to put it right after the saw; the line label turns to a new part worth 3x (val_TL 30 vs val_T 10)
no failure anywhere: minigames floor at 40%, money never runs out into a loss, no game over screen
the Fresa unlocks at level 3, reached in the first minutes from sales and goals; the goal asks for a 3-machine recipe
TLF Albero scanalato 85 vs TFL Mozzo 60; any order not in the book sells as Scarto for 3 (index.html:216)
machine quality is the average of its three phases; the line's value is multiplied by qualityBase + quality
tools speed up minigames; later machines lengthen the chains (up to 5); expansions add lines and a fifth slot
